bifrost: springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs (Presenter), springboard/src/gpu/desktop.rs, springboard/src/gpu/egl.rs, springboard/src/gpu/texture.rs, springboard/src/gpu/shaders.rs, springboard/render/src/glass.rs
summary: BifrOSt has a GPU presenter in the system layer (GBM, EGL, GLES, dma-buf) that composes the desktop; its API is shaped like Metal but apps get no GPU API: no device, command queue, shader library, buffer, texture, compute or blit access from the SDK. Compute, ML, ray tracing, GPU profiling and HDR presentation are absent.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/gpu_device.rs (GpuInventory, RenderNode::from_entry_name); springboard/src/gpu/desktop.rs (GBM device on a render node)
features.note: Render node names, the default device (the lowest node) and its device path are tested headless in tests/parity_sdk-os-02.rs. Gap: apps get no device object, and the shell still opens its own node without this model.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 4 (w4-metal, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. submission is internal to the compositor; no app command buffers

The drawable pool (two or three drawables, take, present, release, abandon, resize only while idle) is tested headless in tests/parity_sdk-os-02.rs. Gap: no application surface is connected to the pool, and built-in apps still submit SHM buffers (docs/wayland-desktop.md).

Pass descriptions are checked headless in tests/parity_sdk-os-02.rs: one to eight colour attachments with load and store actions, one target size, and the three fixed pipelines chosen by name. Gap: apps cannot submit draw calls, and the presenter does not take its passes from this model yet.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 6 (b10, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. no app-supplied shaders, no shader compilation API; shaders are fixed in the compositor

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 4 (w4-metal, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. textures are compositor-internal; no app resource creation or upload API

features.bifrost: springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs (BufferInfo, create_surface buffer count), springboard/src/gpu/damage.rs, springboard/src/gpu/buffer_pool.rs (BufferPool, Fence)
features.note: Damage tracking, multi-buffer swap and a reusable buffer pool with per-submission fences work and are tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-complete-32.rs. Gap: no events or heaps, and the compositor does not yet hand its surfaces to the pool, so the lab machine is needed to check the GPU waits on Midget.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 4 (w4-metal, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no compute path; BifrOSt raster renderer is CPU (docs/wayland-desktop.md)

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 2 (theme-09, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no app-facing buffer to texture copy

features.apple: MTLTensor, MPSGraph inference in a command encoder
features.note: A model of dense, relu and softmax layers runs as a prediction over tensor features, tested in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-gaps-02.rs. Gap: the evaluator runs on the CPU and there is no GPU tensor or command encoder path.

features.apple: MetalFX and Core Image style effects on the GPU
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/gpu_pass.rs (blur_divisor, blur_plan); springboard/render/src/glass.rs (dual-Kawase blur), springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs (glass composite)
features.note: The blur divisor for each radius, the working size and the full-size fallback for small targets are tested headless in tests/parity_sdk-os-02.rs, with the shell's thresholds. Gap: apps cannot run the glass composite, and the shell does not read its divisor from this model.

BGRA and NV12 layouts (plane sizes, row padding, total size, byte addressing) are tested headless in tests/parity_sdk-os-02.rs. Gap: decoding stays in the media layer, and apps get no frame or texture handle.

features.apple: Metal HDR content and extended dynamic range layers
features.note: Pure model: the PQ and HLG curves, extended range headroom and per-frame metadata with MaxCLL and MaxFALL. Tests: the_perceptual_quantizer_maps_black_and_the_peak_to_the_ends_of_the_code_range, headroom_is_the_peak_over_the_reference_and_values_are_clamped_to_it, a_frame_reports_its_peak_and_mean_codes_and_the_running_light_levels (springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-tests-10.rs). Not wired into apps or the presenter, which is 8-bit SDR; not yet tested on the VM or Midget

features.feature: GPU profiling, counters and frame capture
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 5 (w5-metal, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no GPU timing or capture for apps

features.apple: Metal in Simulator, render path fallback
features.bifrost: springboard/src/gpu/mod.rs (CPU and GPU render fallbacks, BIFROST_GPU=0); springboard/src/gpu/render_path.rs (choose, Choice, Reason)
features.note: The render path rule (GPU when present, CPU when BIFROST_GPU=0 or no GPU) is a pure function tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-complete-32.rs, and the compositor falls back to shared memory. Gap: apps do not yet query the path, and there is no simulator target, so the lab machine is needed for the fallback on Midget.

gaps: No app-facing GPU device, command queue or command buffer in the SDK
No app shader library: apps cannot supply Metal or GLSL shaders
No app buffer or texture resource API
No compute, blit or indirect command encoding
No GPU ray tracing or ML inference path
No GPU counters, timing or frame capture for developers
The Vulkan backend behind the presenter is not started (docs/gpu-first.md)
